Ok, update This Django project for another tool in the same project
The website link I am sharing with you: I want you to build an exact version of it where people can, generate music with multiplte features of studio app and refining options similar to of what in website.
There is a save feature. That's it.https://suno.com/create
Using the REA skill & Ghidra (as this is also getting used to reverse engineer any app or website), reverse engineer this, understand the tech stack, and build an exact similar tool which I can use. Verify each part of tool's UI after building it that everything is working fine.

https://suno.com/create
Above link is open with login ID in chrome, check and retry to build using the REA skill & Ghidra.
ok, i restarted Freebuff, now continue to build https://suno.com/create using REA skill and Ghidra. Analayze other features of https://suno.com to update my project.

I’ll retry REA against the live Suno page now that Freebuff has restarted, then use what’s observable there to refine the Django studio. I’ll use Ghidra only if the inspection exposes an actual binary artifact to analyze; it isn’t a browser-page inspection tool.

An original Django music-creation app inspired by the workflow of a hosted AI music service. It has three surfaces, each at its own URL:

| Route | Surface | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `/create` | Create | Songs/Speech and Simple/Advanced composer, Audio/Voice/Inspo tools, lyrics editor with named drafts and a local draft writer, styles with saved prompts, More Options (vocal gender, duration, Max Mode, weirdness, style influence, variety, personalize), your clip library with search, filters, sort, list/grid view and pagination |
| `/studio` | Studio | Multitrack timeline with draggable clips, transport and playhead, per-track mute/solo/volume, track rename/remove, zoom, import, BPM and master level, studio prompt bar for arrangement directions, creative companion panel, project list, JSON export |

The brand, copy, layout, colors, and interface are distinct from the site that inspired the workflow.

## Run locally

```bash
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
# macOS/Linux: source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver
```

Visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/,  [… 87 characters omitted] trol to register or sign in; passwords must contain at least eight characters. Before deployment, set a random `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY`, use `DJANGO_DEBUG=0`, configure `DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, and use a production database and HTTPS. The included SQLite configuration is intended for local development, not a multi-process production deployment.

Django caches templates in this configuration, so restart the development server after editing a template.

## Saving

- **Signed in:** Create writes clips to `/api/jobs/`; Studio autosaves the current arrangement to `/api/projects/` and lists saved projects in the sidebar. Both are filtered to the signed-in user on the server.
- **Guest:** composer settings, lyric drafts, saved styles, and clips are kept in `localStorage` for that browser only. The UI says so where the choice matters.

## REST API

Session-authenticated DRF endpoints under `/api/`:

- `POST /api/auth/register/`, `POST /api/auth/login/`, `POST /api/auth/logout/`
- `GET|POST /api/projects/`; `GET|PATCH|DELETE /api/projects/{uuid}/`
- `GET|POST /api/jobs/`; `GET|PATCH|DELETE /api/jobs/{uuid}/`
- `POST /api/jobs/{uuid}/refine/` with `{ "instruction": "more space around the keys" }`

Projects and jobs are filtered by the authenticated user on every request. Django session auth enforces CSRF checks on unsafe requests.

## Music generation boundary

No music-generation provider is configured, and the app does not pretend otherwise. The built-in `demo` provider stores a generation request as a clip, but synthesizes **no audio**; the UI labels clips as “Prompt saved”. `studioapp/services.py` is the integration boundary for a future licensed provider; setting `MUSIC_PROVIDER` to an unsupported adapter marks jobs as failed instead of fabricating audio. Curated cards on Home and the global playbar are previews with no audio file attached. Importing a local audio file adds an arrangement layer; the upload itself is not persisted to server storage.

The Studio prompt bar and the companion panel record arrangement directions in the project. They do not generate parts, because part generation needs a connected provider.

```bash
python manage.py check
python manage.py test studioapp
node --check static/app.js
node --check static/home.js
node --check static/create.js
node --check static/studio.js
```

{"kind":"tool","id":"jB_ookE6yPU","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"README.md","instructions":"Document the real audio provider, local preview engine, and playback.","content":"# Cadence Studio

An original Django music-creation app inspired by the workflow of a hosted AI music service. It has three surfaces, each at its own URL:

| Route | Surface | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | Home | Discover feed: prompt hero that hands off to Create, artist spotlight carousel, For You / Staff Picks / Best of Cadence rails, style cloud, New Albums grid, global playbar |
| `/create` | Create | Songs/Speech and Simple/Advanced composer, Audio/Voice/Inspo tools, lyrics editor with named drafts and a local draft writer, styles with saved prompts, More Options (vocal gender, duration, Max Mode, weirdness, style influence, variety, personalize), your clip library with search, filters, sort, list/grid view and pagination |
| `/studio` | Studio | Multitrack timeline with draggable clips, transport and playhead, per-track mute/solo/volume, track rename/remove, zoom, import, BPM and master level, studio prompt bar for arrangement directions, creative companion panel, project list, JSON export |

The brand, copy, layout, colors, and interface are distinct from the site that inspired the workflow.

## Run locally

```bash
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
# macOS/Linux: source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver
```

Visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/, [… 1,420 characters omitted] aches the browser. Restart the server after changing it, then check the provider chip at the top of `/create`: it switches from "Local preview engine" to "WaveSpeedAI".

Generation is asynchronous on WaveSpeedAI. `POST /api/jobs/` returns a running job, and `GET /api/jobs/{id}/` polls the provider, stores `audio_url` when the task completes, and reports failures in `error`. The Create page polls newly submitted clips and updates the badge when they are ready. A submitted task is never retried automatically, because a retry can create a second billed task.

Curated cards on Home play locally rendered previews; their titles and artists are original sample content, not a real catalogue. Studio clips play their own preview until you import audio or open a generated clip, at which point the real file is used. Imported files use a session-only object URL and are not uploaded.

Speech needs a voice model and is not connected; submitting the Speech tab reports that plainly instead of fabricating audio. Reference audio and the "Help me start a draft" writer remain local-only.

## Saving

- **Signed in:** Create writes clips to `/api/jobs/`; Studio autosaves the current arrangement to `/api/projects/` and lists saved projects in the sidebar. Both are filtered to the signed-in user on the server.
- **Guest:** composer settings, lyric drafts, saved styles, and clips are kept in `localStorage` for that browser only. Guest clips do not render audio because generation requires a server account.

## REST API

Session-authenticated DRF endpoints under `/api/`:

- `POST /api/auth/register/`, `POST /api/auth/login/`, `POST /api/auth/logout/`
